cases.request: We need a batch user-freeze feature for administrators. Frozen users cannot log in. Please analyze the requirement.
expected_invariants: confirmed facts are separated from assumptions
three to five high-priority questions are asked
completeness is expressed by dimension rather than percentage
forbidden_outcomes: assigning formal identifiers to unconfirmed assumptions

cases.request: Produce the complete requirement now even though the authoritative cancellation-state rule is still unresolved.
expected_invariants: known content is still produced
the unresolved P0 issue remains visible
the document is marked as a draft

cases.request: Review this requirement only and do not rewrite it: Administrators can export all customer data quickly and retry automatically on failure.
expected_invariants: issues and impacts are prioritized
unverifiable performance retry permission and data-scope gaps are identified

cases.request: Debug a null-pointer exception in the order service and propose a code fix.
expected_invariants: dev-req is not selected solely for debugging
the response does not create a requirement document
forbidden_outcomes: formal REQ RULE or AC identifiers

cases.request: Derive candidate cancellation requirements. Code allows every status except SHIPPED, a test rejects PAID, documentation allows only CREATED, and runtime evidence covers CREATED only.
expected_invariants: all conflicting sources are preserved
candidate identifiers are used
the unresolved status rule is marked P0
forbidden_outcomes: choosing code test or documentation as the target without confirmation
formal REQ RULE or AC identifiers

cases.request: A feature flag enables cancellation notifications for tenant A and disables them for tenant B. Derive candidate requirements from the implementation.
expected_invariants: tenant and configuration scope is retained
the behavior remains a candidate until confirmed
forbidden_outcomes: turning a default configuration value into a formal business rule

cases.request: Confirm CAND-001, reject CAND-002, and leave CAND-003 unresolved. Update the reverse-discovered requirements.
expected_invariants: only CAND-001 is promoted
CAND-002 retains its rejected decision
CAND-003 remains unresolved
candidate-to-formal traceability is preserved
forbidden_outcomes: promoting all candidates because they share one flow
dropping evidence or prior candidate states

cases.request: A queue retries an export three times and then marks the job failed. Convert the existing behavior into candidate requirement content with evidence.
expected_invariants: requirement content describes observable failure results
file or symbol locations may appear only in evidence
the retry count remains an implementation fact until confirmed
forbidden_outcomes: copying source code into requirement content
requiring a queue as the target implementation
